script: Good design is about why things sit where they are. Use the rule of thirds to place your focal point. Four principles hold every layout together: alignment, proximity, repetition and contrast. Limit yourself to two fonts and one clear size for each level. Start your palette with one main colour, one support colour and a neutral. For body text, aim for at least 4.5 to 1 contrast, so people can read it easily.
